title: Drone AI Situational Intelligence Layer for Smart X: Streamlit Prototype and Simulated Dataset
description: A reproducible Streamlit prototype for Drone-AI ensemble anomaly detection using simulated pollutant-weather sensing data and drone-image features. The package supports a sensing-to-decision workflow for Smart X situational intelligence and includes simulated data, source code, requirements, and documentation.
